COURTS OF JUDICATURE ACT 1964

RULES OF THE COURT OF APPEAL (AMENDMENT) 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 17 of the Courts of Judicature Act 1964
[Act 91 ] and with the consent of the Chief Justice, the Rules Committee makes the
following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Rules of the Court of Appeal
(Amendment) 2013.

   (2)  These Rules come into operation on 1 March 2013.

Amendment of rule 17
2. The Rules of the Court of Appeal 1994 [P.U. (A) 524/1994], which are referred to
as the "principal Rules" in these Rules, are amended in subrule 17(1) by substituting for
the words "five hundred" the words "one thousand".

Substitution of Second Schedule
3. The principal Rules are amended by sub stituting for the Second Schedule the
following schedule:

"SECOND SCHEDULE

Court Fees

(Rule 56)

1. Notice of Appeal and Cross-Appeal 600.00
2. Any Interlocutory Application 100.00
3. Memorandum of Appeal 100.00

4. On application to prepare an Index 100.00
5. (a)  Order on any interlocutory application 100.00
 (b)  Final order on appeal 200.00
6. Notice of Motion  180.00
7. Search Fees 12.00"

Made 27 February 2013
[JK/MP 322 Jld. 11; PN(PU2)153/XV]
